idea-plugin.name: Phem
idea-plugin.description:
Language support for Phem .phem files. A .phem file is a PHP file with markup literals and Twig, the same way a .jsx file is JavaScript with JSX.

Features

  • Syntax highlighting: PHP, markup literals (elements, components, named slots, fragments), Twig ({{ }}, {% %}, {# #}), and the JavaScript and CSS of <script> and <style>.
  • Diagnostics as you type: the errors and warnings of the compiler, also for unsaved changes.
  • Completion:
    • component tags, with the required props and the use import;
    • props, named slots (<Card:footer>), and closing tags;
    • HTML elements and attributes, Phem events (onClick), and Phem attributes (phem:loading, phem:bind, ...);
    • Twig variables, attributes, filters, tests, functions, tags, and route names in path('...');
    • PHP members after -> and ::, variables, classes, functions, and use statements.
  • Go to Declaration: components, slots, props, PHP symbols, Twig variables and attributes, handlers (onClick={{ like }}), and route names.
  • Quick Documentation: signatures and props, and the docs of Twig, HTML elements, and HTML attributes.
  • Find Usages and usage counts: the tags of a component, the calls of a function, and the calls and Twig handlers of a method. A count (2 usages) shows above each declaration.
  • Structure view and breadcrumbs: the namespace, components with their props and slots, pages with their paths, and classes with their members.
  • Twig comments: Comment with Line Comment writes {# ... #} in markup.

Requirements

  • Node.js, for the bundled language server. Or a native phemc binary.

Settings

Open Settings | Languages & Frameworks | Phem to set the source directory of the .phem files (default: src), the Node.js path, and the phemc path.
